reader.zh-Hant: URLSecondaryLLMSummarizerTool 會讀取 URL 內容，使用次要 LLM 產出 300 字內摘要、關鍵字與重點，並強制保留指定原文內容。
reader.en: URLSecondaryLLMSummarizerTool reads URL content and uses a secondary LLM to produce <=300-char summary, keywords, and key points while preserving required original content.
reader.ja: URLSecondaryLLMSummarizerTool は URL 内容を読み取り、二次 LLM で 300 文字以内の要約・キーワード・重要点を生成し、指定原文の保持を強制します。

symbols.name: URLSecondaryLLMSummarizerTool
symbols.summary: Summarize web content with a secondary LLM and preserve mandatory source snippets.

tool_contract.name: summarize_url_with_secondary_llm
tool_contract.description: Summarize URL content with a secondary LLM and preserve required source content.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(url: str, preserve_original_content: str, instruction: str, max_summary_chars: int = 300, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Returns JSON summary payload with optional file-routing mode. Falls back to heuristic summarizer when secondary LLM is not configured.

examples.title: Summarize URL with mandatory preserved snippet

runtime_notes.content: Uses SECONDARY_LLM_PROVIDER / SECONDARY_LLM_MODEL / SECONDARY_LLM_API_KEY / SECONDARY_LLM_API_URL when available.
If secondary LLM is missing or fails, tool still returns structured summary with warning and secondary_llm_used=false.
